issues.failure_explanation: In (2.88), transitioning from the first equality to the second equality requires subtracting $\mathbb{A}_h((\mathbb{T}-\mathbb{T}_h)\mathbf{u}_j, I_h \mathbb{T}^*\mathbf{u}_i^*) + \mathbb{B}_h(I_h\mathbb{T}^*\mathbf{u}_i^*, \mathbb{S}^*\mathbf{u}_i^* - \mathbb{S}_h^*\mathbf{u}_i^*) + \overline{\mathbb{B}_h((\mathbb{T}-\mathbb{T}_h)\mathbf{u}_j, \vartheta_h \mathbb{S}^*\mathbf{u}_i^*)}$. By Galerkin orthogonality for the primal problem (2.26)-(2.41), $\mathbb{A}_h((\mathbb{T}-\mathbb{T}_h)\mathbf{u}_j, \mathbf{v}_h) = -\mathbb{B}_h(\mathbf{v}_h, \mathbb{S}\mathbf{u}_j - \mathbb{S}_h\mathbf{u}_j)$ for any $\mathbf{v}_h\in \mathbb{X}_h$. Setting $\mathbf{v}_h = I_h \mathbb{T}^*\mathbf{u}_i^*$, the subtracted quantity equals $\mathbb{B}_h(I_h\mathbb{T}^*\mathbf{u}_i^*, (\mathbb{S}^*\mathbf{u}_i^* - \mathbb{S}_h^*\mathbf{u}_i^*) - (\mathbb{S}\mathbf{u}_j - \mathbb{S}_h\mathbf{u}_j))$, which does not vanish because $\mathbb{S}\mathbf{u}_j - \mathbb{S}_h\mathbf{u}_j$ is the primal pressure error from source $\mathbf{u}_j$ whereas $\mathbb{S}^*\mathbf{u}_i^* - \mathbb{S}_h^*\mathbf{u}_i^*$ is the adjoint pressure error from source $\mathbf{u}_i^*$. This error stems from incorrectly treating the non-self-adjoint Oseen problem as if it were a self-adjoint Stokes problem where primal and adjoint solutions coincide.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Properly dualize the term $((\mathbb{T}-\mathbb{T}_h)\mathbf{u}_j, \mathbf{u}_i^*)$ by expanding $\mathbb{A}_h((\mathbb{T}-\mathbb{T}_h)\mathbf{u}_j, (\mathbb{T}^*-\mathbb{T}_h^*)\mathbf{u}_i^*) + \mathbb{B}_h((\mathbb{T}^*-\mathbb{T}_h^*)\mathbf{u}_i^*, (\mathbb{S}-\mathbb{S}_h)\mathbf{u}_j) + \overline{\mathbb{B}_h((\mathbb{T}-\mathbb{T}_h)\mathbf{u}_j, (\mathbb{S}^*-\mathbb{S}_h^*)\mathbf{u}_i^*)}$ and applying the primal and adjoint Galerkin orthogonality relations with both primal pressure error $\mathbb{S}\mathbf{u}_j - \mathbb{S}_h\mathbf{u}_j$ and adjoint pressure error $\mathbb{S}^*\mathbf{u}_i^* - \mathbb{S}_h^*\mathbf{u}_i^*$ retained and estimated separately.
issues.overall_effect: Estimate (2.80) for the eigenvalue cluster error $|\lambda - \widehat{\lambda}_h| \lesssim h^{2s}$ and estimate (2.85) for $|\lambda - \lambda_h| \lesssim h^{2s}$ are unproven as written, which in turn undermines the eigenvalue error bounds in Theorem 3.8 and Corollary 3.9.
issues.title: Invalid cancellation of primal and adjoint pressure error terms in spectral estimate (2.88)
issues.why_classification: The optimal $O(h^{2s})$ eigenvalue convergence rate remains mathematically valid for non-self-adjoint mixed DG formulations, but proving it requires a contained, nontrivial repair of the duality identity tracking both primal and adjoint pressure error terms rather than the erroneous one-line step in (2.88).
